attribution.reference: Unchanged per-target reference errors from the 0.12 shared-boundary investigation
attribution.classification: Original faultline.bisect predicate; all three workers must agree. Below-threshold numerical growth remains not_shifted.
attribution.nightly_parity: Exact equality of the complete per-target fp64 evidence, plus exact median-log2-growth equality, with the respective 0.12 November 4/5 observations. Report differences rather than silently widening a tolerance.

capture.workload: Unchanged frozen twelve-block GPT-2 prefix from 0.11
capture.required: Capture actual CPU flash forward/backward operator arguments and results, including q/k/v, grad_out, out, logsumexp, scale, dropout, causal flag and attention mask. Preserve tensor storage, offsets, strides and dtype.
capture.instrumentation_control: Require exact output and gradient equality with the same path without capture. Warm compiled forward/backward first; intercept runtime calls without changing the compiled graph. Incomplete interception or changed control results are inconclusive.
capture.comparisons: Report exact value equality separately from shape/dtype/stride/offset/contiguity equality, within and across builds.

kernel.inputs: Every block 11/12 capture from each build and execution path is a separate frozen workload. Feed each identical saved workload to both source builds; do not conflate changed upstream inputs with changed kernels.
kernel.reference: Explicit fp64 QK^T scaling/masking, logsumexp, softmax and PV, with autograd VJP using the captured fixed upstream gradient. Start from the exact saved fp32 values.
kernel.shift_predicate: For each capture, median log2 child/parent RMSE growth across dq, dk, dv must reach log2(1.4) in all three fresh observations. All three parent errors must be positive and finite; absent/nonfinite targets or disagreement are inconclusive. The block-12 shift is reproduced if at least one preregistered block-12 capture qualifies. Report the complete eight-capture matrix, including null results.
kernel.noise_floor_context: Also report errors relative to u*RMS(reference), u=2^-24, and child_error/max(parent_error,8*u*RMS(reference)); these are context and do not replace the fixed raw-growth predicate.

scores.computation: Compute fp64 scaled QK^T plus the recorded mask, before softmax; subtract each row maximum. Separately report masked negative infinities. Threshold counts include only finite permitted entries.
scores.association: For each capture and dq/dk/dv, rank head/row child-to-parent RMSE growth (finite positive parent error only); report overlap and mean growth for rows with any below-threshold entries versus rows without, plus the top ten rows. dq row indexes queries; dk/dv index keys, so also compare key-column exposure rather than treating key rows as queries. No exposure means the proposed subnormal explanation has no observed support in this sample.

exponential.dispatch: AVX512 on the measured host; compile small measurement adapters against each existing build's installed headers and libraries. Do not rebuild PyTorch.
exponential.samples: 2^20+1 evenly spaced fp32 points on [-104,0], plus 2^18+1 on [-110,-86], 2^18+1 on [0,89], and explicit boundary/NaN/infinity values. Sampled coverage, not an exhaustive float-space bound.
exponential.accuracy: Compare outputs with exp in fp64; divide absolute error by the local fp32 spacing, using 2^-149 in the subnormal/zero range. Report normal/subnormal/underflow/overflow and NaN/infinity handling separately. Also record distance to correctly rounded fp32 reference.
exponential.timing: One thread, three fresh workers per build, five warmups then eleven timed iterations per implementation on the fixed [-104,0] array; report medians and spread. Run timings without simultaneous model workers. No performance verdict from a single sample.
exponential.consistency: Use captured q/k and each build's saved forward logsumexp. Compare exp_u20(score-rowmax), normalized row probabilities, and backward exp(score-logsumexp); report row sums, reconstructed logsumexp errors, and probability differences. Include fp64 scores rounded once and actual fp32 bmm scores as explicitly separate reconstructions; neither is asserted to reproduce internal fused BLAS arithmetic bit-for-bit.

standalone.condition: Only lead the upstream draft with a kernel reproducer if the fixed block-12 kernel predicate is met and independently confirmed. Otherwise retain the full-model reproducer and document the kernel null result and unresolved calling/input differences.
standalone.dependencies: PyTorch only, with saved tensors or a separately verified synthetic case; no transformers required for a kernel reproducer.
